This does not corroborate the report of elevated checkout errors in this window. On latency, checkout's server-side p95 is 411.1 ms and its dependency client-side p95s are 4.75-91.1 ms, but no comparable earlier baseline could be retrieved (earlier 5-minute windows returned no_data), so a latency trend/elevation cannot be confirmed or refuted. claims.text: Checkout trace sample: 7 traces over the window; every checkout span shown is non-error. PlaceOrder spans for trace_ids 178b123752bbd30e1b5457f9054240ef, 895308b465410477a32e20d6d585b01c, 4b046045a6520344365ae563bdcd5a2e, 13cd54dbec03a2d8d81a67bbe13a4411, 0fabf9fc2b7d17699975b3e2ad167e2e, 18f197088923fb529759a3ebc767473f and 841b2c79aece1318c727a5c9510109de carry rpc.grpc.status_code 0, and checkout HTTP POST children carry http.status_code 200; no span in the sample carries an error status tag or error detail.

No ERROR series was returned for checkout, cart, product-catalog, shipping or email.

Grouping traces_span_metrics_calls_total by service/status_code over 300s returns only UNSET (and currency OK) series for checkout, cart, product-catalog, currency, shipping and email; no ERROR-status series appears for any of these services in the window.

Checkout's outbound gRPC client counts (rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count increase over 300s) all carry rpc_grpc_status_code 0: PaymentService/Charge 7.11, CurrencyService/Convert 17.50, CartService/EmptyCart 7.11, CartService/GetCart 7.11, ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 10.00, ShippingService/GetQuote 7.11, ShippingService/ShipOrder 7.11; no non-zero gRPC status code is present.

Payment service spans sampled (e.g. trace_id 178b123752bbd30e1b5457f9054240ef) show grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge with rpc.grpc.status_code 0, no error details; the Charge server span took 27.7 ms and the corresponding checkout client span 45.3 ms.

Email spans sampled all carry http.status_code 200 on POST /send_order_confirmation, but with a wide spread: 140706 us (trace_id 178b123752bbd30e1b5457f9054240ef) versus 39909, 22595, 9216, 6322, 5941 and 4003 us in the other traces; no error tags.

Server-side p95 duration (rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_bucket, 300s) in the window: checkout 411.11 ms and product-catalog 4.81 ms; across all services only ad (104.48 ms), checkout, product-catalog and otelcol-contrib expose server duration buckets.

Checkout's client-side p95 duration by callee (rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_bucket, 300s): PaymentService/Charge 45.60 ms, CurrencyService/Convert 14.50 ms, CartService/EmptyCart 66.11 ms, CartService/GetCart 9.16 ms, ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 4.75 ms, ShippingService/GetQuote 91.11 ms, ShippingService/ShipOrder 4.75 ms; only ad, checkout, fraud-detection and otelcol-contrib expose client duration buckets.

Product-catalog trace sample (service-level search, 15 traces, spans_shown 131, spans_omitted 0) shows only non-error spans: server GetProduct spans rpc.grpc.status_code 0 with durations 0.05-4.32 ms and all caller HTTP/gRPC spans at status 200 / 0.

Currency against the span-status view: cart shows only STATUS_CODE_UNSET span series (e.g. HGET 68.75, GetCart 45.00, EMPTYCART 7.12 increase over 300s) and email only UNSET series (send_email 7.12, sinatra.render_template 14.23); no ERROR or non-zero error code is recorded for these.

app_payment_transactions_total increase over 300s returns only positive per-currency values (CAD 1.25, USD 4.71) with no failure/decline label exposed, so no payment decline evidence is available from this metric.

The single noticeably slower checkout trace (178b123752bbd30e1b5457f9054240ef: PlaceOrder 463 ms, email send_order_confirmation 140.7 ms, ShippingService/GetQuote 94.9 ms, CartService/EmptyCart 73.8 ms) may reflect a transient/warm-up effect for the first request of the window rather than sustained degradation, since later traces in the same window show much lower downstream durations.

Directly contradicting the report of elevated checkout errors in this window: the error-status span series is zero for every service that exposes it and absent for checkout and its dependencies, all sampled checkout PlaceOrder spans are rpc.grpc.status_code 0, and all checkout outbound gRPC calls are rpc_grpc_status_code 0.

Rejected: that checkout's dependency calls failed (non-zero gRPC error codes) in this window. The sampled dependency spans (payment, shipping, cart, currency, product-catalog, email) all carry rpc.grpc.status_code 0 or http.status_code 200, and checkout's outbound client counts show only rpc_grpc_status_code 0.
